answer: Stake 10 POA, review three peers, get spot-checked. Each epoch the protocol reruns 5% of reviews with jurors who hold no stake in the reviewed identity. A review that contradicts the sample is slashed, and any attestation arriving from the reviewer's own subnet is taxed 60%. The mechanism stays small, one stake, one sample, one tax. A false echo then costs 10 POA plus the tax, which keeps a sock-puppet ring unprofitable across the horizon we can measure, and the garden of reviewers grows only where real judgments land.
